comment: Plan offensive-words, Phase 0: the pinned inputs read by find_candidates.py to propose the « mots exclus » candidates. Files live under <work>/data/<file> (never in the repository). kaikki.org replaces its extraction about once a week at the same URL, so a later download may not match the SHA-256: the review is tied to the extraction recorded here. LDNOOBW is a cross-check seed only.
